requirements.value: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Physics, Physical Technology, Material Sciences, Computer Sciences
requirements.sourceQuote: Applicants must have a university or university of applied sciences degree (e.g. Bachelor’s degree) in one of the following areas: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Physics, Physical Technology, Material Sciences, Computer Sciences, or the equivalent.
Students must hold a Bachelor’s degree or a German diploma ("Diplom") with a grade of 2.5 or better (German grading system).

English language skills
**B2** required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: 
  * IELTS Academic: 6
